description: What each concept MEANS, for disambiguation when mapping a report line onto a taxonomy tag. A definition is only load-bearing where sibling names alone cannot decide the assignment -- 'Land' vs 'Buildings' is obvious, but an issuer's 'Computer equipment' could plausibly land on Plant and equipment, Office equipment, or Other tangible assets. Definitions therefore state what is INCLUDED and, critically, what is EXCLUDED, so a catch-all bucket does not silently absorb lines that belong to a named sibling. Keyed by taxonomy concept name per statement, matched case/punctuation-insensitively (fdi.core.concepts.normalize). Concepts absent here fall back to a structural description derived from the hierarchy; add an entry only when a real ambiguity is observed, not for completeness.

profit_and_loss.Revenue From Operations — Gross Revenue: Turnover from the entity's principal business before deducting indirect taxes (GST/excise) and before other income. Excludes interest, dividend, rent and gains on asset/investment disposal, which are Other income.
profit_and_loss.Revenue from Sale of Products: Revenue from goods manufactured or produced by the entity. Excludes goods bought and resold without processing (Revenue from Traded Goods) and service fees.
profit_and_loss.Revenue from Sale of Services: Revenue from rendering services, including consultancy, IT, professional and support services. For a services company this is normally the dominant revenue line.
profit_and_loss.Revenue from Traded Goods: Revenue from goods purchased and resold substantially unchanged, including equipment and third-party software licences resold to customers.
profit_and_loss.Other Operating Revenues: Recurring income incidental to the principal business (scrap sales, export incentives, duty drawback). Excludes non-operating items such as interest and dividend.
profit_and_loss.Other income: Income outside the principal business: interest, dividend, rent, net gains on disposal or fair valuation of assets and investments, and foreign-exchange gains.
profit_and_loss.Interest: Interest earned on bank deposits, loans given, and financial assets. Excludes interest PAID, which is a finance cost.
profit_and_loss.Dividend: Dividend income from investments, including dividends received from subsidiaries and associates.
profit_and_loss.Expenses: All costs charged against income for the period, before tax and before exceptional or extraordinary items.
profit_and_loss.Cost of Materials Consumed: Raw materials and components consumed in production. Excludes purchases of finished goods for resale (stock-in-trade) and stores/spares consumed.
profit_and_loss.Employee benefit expense: All staff costs: salaries, wages, incentives, allowances, contributions to provident and other funds, share-based payments and staff welfare.
profit_and_loss.Finance costs: Interest and borrowing costs on debt, lease-liability interest, and bank charges. Excludes principal repayment and excludes interest INCOME.
profit_and_loss.Depreciation, depl. & amortz. exp: Systematic charge writing down tangible assets (depreciation), intangible assets (amortisation), right-of-use assets and depletion. Excludes impairment losses, which are a separate concept.
profit_and_loss.Impairment Loss - Other than IMPL, IMPA: Write-down of an asset's carrying value below its recoverable amount. Distinct from routine depreciation/amortisation.
profit_and_loss.Other expenses: Operating expenses not separately classified above: power and fuel, rent, repairs, travel, legal and professional fees, advertising, insurance, CSR, and miscellaneous items.
profit_and_loss.Tax expense: Total income-tax charge for the period: current tax plus deferred tax, including prior-year adjustments. Excludes indirect taxes such as GST.
profit_and_loss.Current tax: Tax payable on the taxable profit of the current period, including MAT where applicable. Excludes deferred tax.
profit_and_loss.Deferred tax: Tax effect of temporary differences between accounting and tax bases. Often a credit (negative) when reversing.
profit_and_loss.Other comprehensive income (Net): Gains and losses recognised outside profit or loss: remeasurement of defined-benefit plans, fair-value changes on FVOCI investments, and cash-flow hedge movements.
profit_and_loss.Prior period, exceptional, extraordinary: Material, non-recurring items disclosed separately from ordinary operating results, such as restructuring costs, one-off legal provisions and statutory impacts.

assets.Fixed assets/PPE Gross Block - Closing: Original cost of tangible fixed assets at period end, BEFORE deducting accumulated depreciation. Read the 'cost/gross carrying amount as at' row, never the net row.
assets.Fixed assets/PPE Net Block - Closing: Carrying amount of tangible fixed assets at period end AFTER deducting accumulated depreciation. Read the 'net carrying amount as at' row.
assets.Land: Freehold and leasehold land. Excludes buildings standing on it.
assets.Buildings: Structures and premises, including factory and office buildings. Excludes the land beneath them and excludes leasehold improvements to premises not owned.
assets.Plant and equipment: Machinery and operating equipment, including computer and IT hardware and office equipment where the issuer does not disclose those separately. Excludes land, buildings, vehicles and furniture.
assets.Furniture and fixtures: Furniture, fittings and fixtures. Excludes office equipment and computer hardware.
assets.Vehicles: Motor vehicles owned by the entity.
assets.Leasehold improvements: Capitalised improvements to premises the entity does not own. Excludes owned buildings.
assets.Other tangible assets: Tangible fixed assets that fit no named sibling. Use ONLY after checking every named class; do not use it as a default.
assets.Intangible assets - Gross Block: Original cost of intangible assets at period end before amortisation: software, goodwill, brands, licences, patents.
assets.Intangible Assets-Net Block: Carrying amount of intangible assets after accumulated amortisation and impairment.
assets.Non-Current Investments: Investments intended to be held beyond twelve months, including investments in subsidiaries, associates and joint ventures.
assets.Current investments (Net): Investments realisable within twelve months, such as mutual funds, short-term bonds and reverse-repo balances.
assets.Inventories: Goods held for sale, in production, or consumed in production: raw materials, work-in-progress, finished goods, stock-in-trade, stores and spares.
assets.Current trade receivables (Net): Amounts due from customers within twelve months, net of loss allowance. Includes billed and unbilled revenue where disclosed. Excludes advances paid to suppliers.
Cash on hand, balances in current accounts, and deposits. Note that 'cash and cash equivalents' as reported often already includes short-term bank balances; bank deposits held beyond three months or under lien are usually disclosed separately.
assets.Cash balance: Cash and cash equivalents: cash on hand, cheques on hand, remittances in transit, and bank balances in current and short-maturity deposit accounts.
assets.Bank balance: Bank balances disclosed SEPARATELY from cash and cash equivalents, typically deposits with maturity over three months, earmarked balances and amounts under lien.
assets.Non Current financial assets: Financial assets recoverable after twelve months: long-term loans, deposits, and other financial assets.
assets.Current financial assets: Financial assets recoverable within twelve months: advances, prepaid expenses, interest receivable, security deposits and other short-term financial assets.

liabilities.Non-current & current liabilities — Borr: Interest-bearing debt from banks, financial institutions and others: term loans, working capital facilities, bonds, debentures, commercial paper and deposits. A debt-free entity reports none of these.
liabilities.Term loans: Borrowings repayable per a fixed schedule beyond one year, split into current and non-current portions.
liabilities.Working capital loans, Short Term Loan,: Short-term bank facilities financing operations: cash credit, overdraft, packing credit and other working-capital lines.
liabilities.Lease liabilities: Obligation to make lease payments, measured at the present value of remaining payments, split into current and non-current.
liabilities.Trade payables: Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services, including dues to micro and small enterprises disclosed separately under MSMED.
liabilities.Other Liabilities: Non-borrowing, non-trade obligations: statutory dues, employee payables, unearned and deferred revenue, unpaid dividends, security deposits received and other payables.
liabilities.Provisions: Liabilities of uncertain timing or amount recognised from a present obligation: employee benefits, warranties, litigation and other provisions. Excludes trade payables and accruals with certain amounts.

equity.Share capital: Issued, subscribed and paid-up capital at face value. Excludes securities premium and all reserves.
equity.Other Equity: All shareholders' funds other than paid-up share capital: reserves, retained earnings, securities premium, and accumulated other comprehensive income.
equity.Reserves: Appropriations and statutory/specific reserves: general reserve, capital reserve, capital redemption reserve, securities premium, debenture redemption reserve and revaluation reserve.
equity.Retained earnings or statement of profit: Cumulative undistributed profits carried forward, after dividends and transfers to and from other reserves.
